title: On Robust Alpha-Damping Viscous Scheme
summary: In this paper, we investigate the convergence of an implicit defect-correction solver for a viscous discretization based on the alpha-damping scheme for unstructured grids. We show that significantly more robust iterative convergence is achieved by evaluating the damping term at the midpoint between two adjacent cell centers (edge midpoint) rather than at the face centroid. A one-dimensional Fourier analysis reveals that the implicit solver tends to be stable when the damping term in the residual is smaller than that used to construct the Jacobian.
